family_reports.body: The system has torn my family apart

They lost my son, he has been missing since September 23, 2025. They have consistently tried to cover up the unconstitutional seizure of my children. They scrubbed reports and gave my 8 year old daughter to our abuser and placed my 15 year old daughter with a pedophile.

The system tried to destroy and break our family simply for money because three of our children have disabilities they could cash in on. That same system tried to silence us l, paint us as liars, when the proof didn’t match the story they were telling. WE WILL NEVER STOP TELLING OUR STORY!!! If we help and save just one other family it was not for nothing. We are together. Our family fights together. They chose the wrong ones. All of my children are home because our voices, our proof, MATTERED.

public_comments.comment_text: Submitted lies to the judge to obtain a non secured custody order. Gave documentation to him to show he d made an error which he refused to correct because his social workers would not give him false information. Interviewed children without anyone else present. Told my son he would never see me again if he changed his story. Threatened me directly saying I could keep fighting the allegations but I was only making it harder on the children because I would never see them and would be severely restricted in my contact with them, which they did until I got louder and louder and making complaints with the state and making TikTok’s. Would not authorize my son’s picture to be released to news outlets when he ran away from placement for the 4th time and was missing two months. Help suppress evidence and threatened law enforcement with law suites that were trying to help my son as he claimed physically and sexual assault by the facility he was placed in without a court order.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: He was the DSS attorney and reported falsely to the judge statements he said I made. Said the workers would not lie and that I was just changing my story now. I told him the statement Abby Williams made me write n that I was in a locked room. He said I just don’t believe that but he still submitted that letter as fact. He told a judge I was fearful of my parents and that was a lie. He told a judge there was no one else to take me also a lie proven by many letters my mother has that she submitted to him from herself and my family. He also tried to block me from speaking with the judge.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Has lied continuously, his court interpretations are quite warped and it's alarming he is still allowed to practice law without a serious psychological evaluation. MANY families have grievances with him. He has enabled the abuse of my children and acts as though he's untouchable. He throws tantrums when the judges don't do exactly what he wants, I've actually seen him storm out of the courtroom and I've also seen him so mad he started to pack up his belongings as the judge was still speaking. I have several pages of complaints against this one.
